description: Cosmic Sentinel is an interactive Planetary Defense simulator dashboard designed to model asteroids deflection trajectories using kinetic impactor physics inspired by NASA's DART mission.
summary: Cosmic Sentinel is a Python-based interactive command-line simulator designed to help space mission planners optimize critical parameters such as total budget, payload mass, and power constraints. By functioning as an intelligent decision-support tool, it evaluates user inputs against predefined mission thresholds and calculates real-time feasibility metrics to determine potential success or failure. This project addresses the core challenges of space mission design by providing a fast, lightweight, and programmatic approach to resource allocation and constraint verification before actual deployment. It is important because it streamlines early-stage mission planning, ensuring cost-efficiency and technical viability for future space exploration initiatives.
details: Cosmic Sentinel is a Python-based space mission design simulator developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It is designed to model, analyze, and optimize space mission parameters efficiently using Python scripts. The project utilizes structured code repositories and automated logic to assist space exploration data handling. It offers a lightweight, extensible software architecture that helps researchers and space enthusiasts simulate mission scenarios with ease.
